SUBJECT: LETTER OF REPUDIATION - CLAIM REF # CLM-20491

Dear Policyholder,

With reference to the reimbursement claim submitted for the hospitalization of the above patient from 10-Feb-2026 to 14-Feb-2026 at Apollo Hospital for Total Knee Arthroplasty (Left), we have scrutinized the submitted records in accordance with the terms and conditions of Policy #SH-884920.

GROUNDS FOR REPUDIATION:
Under Clause 4.2 of the Policy Terms:
"Waiting period of 24 months from inception of policy shall apply to specified diseases/procedures including Joint Replacement Surgeries, unless necessitated by accidental bodily injury."

Based on the discharge summary and medical history, the current joint replacement procedure is elective for degenerative joint disease and falls within the waiting period restriction under Clause 4.2. Hence, your claim of INR 1,84,500 stands REPUDIATED.

If you are not satisfied with this decision, you may represent your case before our Grievance Redressal Officer within 30 days.

Yours sincerely,
Authorized Signatory
Star Health Claims Department
